Illustrative arithmetic examples, not seeded-user scenarios. Matching total is round(skill overlap*50 + availability ratio*30 + experience ratio*20), clamped 0–100. Availability ratios: exact 1, flexible .9, missing .6, incompatible .2. Experience affinity: +1/+2 tiers 1, +3 .9, same .65, lower .25. Skill overlap uses shared skills / learner skills, or .5 when none selected. Progress uses 70/30 when both types exist, 100% for the only existing type, 0% for no records. COMPLETED forces100%, rather than assessing competency.

Reward service checks badges and refreshes ranks; notification helper records events. Updates need no background queue.
